info.title: School Management System
info.description:
Versioned REST API of the School Management System for mobile and third-party clients.

Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/token` and send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. All responses are JSON. Lists are paginated (`page`, `per_page` up to 100) and support `filter[...]` and `sort` (prefix with `-` for descending) parameters where documented.

Errors use a consistent envelope: `{"message": "...", "errors": {"field": ["..."]}}` with HTTP 401, 403, 404, 422 or 429.

post.description:
Records (or updates) attendance for several students of the class on
one date in a single transaction. Every student must be actively
enrolled in the class.

get.description:
Scoped to the caller. Filters: `filter[section_id]`,
`filter[student_id]`, `filter[status]`, `filter[from]` and
`filter[to]` (Y-m-d). Sorts: `date`.

Duplicate records for the same student, class and date are rejected
with 422; use the class register endpoint to update a whole session.

put.summary: Update an attendance record's status or remarks

post.description:
Exchanges credentials for a personal access token. Send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests. Limited to
five attempts per minute per email and IP address.

get.description:
Admins see every class, teachers the classes they teach and students
the classes they are enrolled in. Filters: `filter[academic_term_id]`,
`filter[course_id]`, `filter[teacher_id]`, `filter[status]`.
Include: `course`, `term`, `teacher`.

put.description:
Capacity cannot be reduced below the current enrollment; cancelling a
class drops its active enrollments.

delete.description: Classes with enrollment records cannot be deleted; cancel them instead.

get.description:
Per-assessment averages, each student's weighted score and letter
grade, the class average and the grade distribution.

Per-student attendance counts and rates for the class. Optional
`from` and `to` (Y-m-d) limit the date range.

get.description:
Scoped to the caller: admins see all, teachers their classes, students
their own. Filters: `filter[student_id]`, `filter[section_id]`,
`filter[status]`. Include: `student`, `section`. Sorts: `enrolled_at`.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Enforces student status, class status, the term's enrollment window,
prerequisites, duplicate enrollments and class capacity. Rule
violations return 422 with the reason.
post.summary: Enroll a student in a class

get.summary: Show an enrollment with its status history

post.description: Freezes the current weighted score as the final score and letter grade.

get.description:
Assessments of the classes visible to the caller. Filters:
`filter[section_id]`, `filter[type]`. Sorts: `due_on`, `title`.

get.description:
Students only ever receive their own grades; teachers the grades of
their classes. Filters: `filter[section_id]`, `filter[student_id]`,
`filter[assessment_id]`, `filter[enrollment_id]`. Include: `assessment`.

post.description:
Creates the grade, or updates the existing one for the same assessment
and enrollment (201 when created, 200 when updated). The score must be
between 0 and the assessment's maximum and the enrollment must be
active in the assessment's class.

get.description:
Admins see all students, teachers see students enrolled in their classes.
Filters: `filter[search]` (name, email or number), `filter[status]`,
`filter[grade_level]`. Sorts: `last_name`, `student_number`,
`admission_date`, `grade_level`, `created_at`.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

put.description:
Partial updates are supported. Status changes are recorded in the
student's history; withdrawing a student drops their active enrollments.

delete.description:
Soft delete: active enrollments are dropped and the login is disabled.
The record is purged after the configured retention period.

date.description: Session date (Y-m-d); not in the future and within the term.

reason.description: Optional note stored in the enrollment status history.
Optional note stored in the enrollment status history.
